name: kimiflow
description: Lean verified delivery for Codex, Astra and local models, with optional managed-run compatibility.

interface.shortDescription: Lean feature/fix delivery, current-source checks and optional project tools
interface.longDescription: Understand the request, build with the selected model and native host tools, then verify current source and deliver. Fresh work needs no routine confirmation, phase ledger, fixed reviewer ensemble or memory write. Existing managed runs resume with their pinned gates. Optional project intelligence, repo docs, findings, memory, security and release tools load only on request. No automatic paid-provider fallback.
defaultPrompt: Use Kimiflow to implement this feature and verify it
Use Kimiflow to fix this bug with regression evidence
Open Kimiflow and show project status
